notes: No state rows. PepsiCo published an Oxford Economics report on its 2024 U.S. economic impact (pepsico.com/about/economic-impact and PDF 'PepsiCo_2024_US-impact.pdf', with a state-level appendix); pepsico.com's Imperva bot protection returned 403 / 'Access denied, Error 15' to curl, WebFetch and a headless browser on 2026-11-23, so it could not be read and nothing from it is recorded. A later run from a normal browser could add a company-commissioned 50-state set (jobs supported, GDP contribution). The 10-K gives ~319,000 employees with ~134,000 in the U.S. (US country row), no other country or state split. Item 2 lists significant properties by division without counts by state or country; 12 of its 18 rows are used as sites (Russia plants, Israel, Vallejo, Colonia and Singapore omitted).
